description: TfL publishes the geographic boundary of the Greater London Authority road network for which it acts as highway authority. The source describes the Transport for London Road Network, or red routes. Polygon metadata includes authority identifier, borough, version and change-date fields. This legal-administrative extent differs from the road-centreline dataset and does not establish actual traffic conditions, lane geometry or maintenance condition. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
